original.statement: In Karpenter 1.0.0, the annotations karpenter.sh/do-not-consolidate, karpenter.sh/do-not-evict, and the tag karpenter.sh/managed-by are removed; karpenter.sh/managed-by is replaced by eks:eks-cluster-name, and the disruption taint key changed from karpenter.sh/disruption=disrupting:NoSchedule to karpenter.sh/disrupted:NoSchedule.

decision.reason: [ev-f83dc72c2c99] lists several separate changes: Ubuntu is dropped as a first-class AMI family, two annotations and one tag are removed (with karpenter.sh/managed-by replaced by eks:eks-cluster-name), and the disruption taint is renamed. None of these is an RBAC permission, so the subject "rbac-permission removed-annotations-and-tags" is invented and lumps unrelated changes into one. A single "removed" assertion can't correctly cover all of them, so each change has to be asserted on its own.
